Transport Modes

Cuộn dây đai

A manual or mechanical device used to wind and collect strapping material after securing cargo loads, improving efficiency and safety in warehouse and transport operations.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Cuộn dây đai?

In this glossary, Cuộn dây đai refers to: A manual or mechanical device used to wind and collect strapping material after securing cargo loads, improving efficiency and safety in warehouse and transport operations.

How is Cuộn dây đai used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Sau khi cố định hàng hóa, nhân viên kho dùng cuộn dây đai để tháo và cất giữ dây đai thừa trên pallet một cách an toàn."

Why does Cuộn dây đai matter in logistics?

Cuộn dây đai matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Modes contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Cuộn dây đai?

Cuộn dây đai is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A manual or mechanical device used to wind and collect strapping material after securing cargo loads, improving efficiency and safety in warehouse and transport operations.

Operational example

After securing the cargo, the warehouse staff used a strap winder to safely remove and store excess strapping from the pallets.

Localized term

Cuộn dây đai

Localized example

Sau khi cố định hàng hóa, nhân viên kho dùng cuộn dây đai để tháo và cất giữ dây đai thừa trên pallet một cách an toàn.
